overview-page.title: Overview

no-save.title: Choose a Save
no-save.save-location: Save files can be found at <1>{{path}}</1>.
no-save.supported_saves: Reads and writes base game and Spaced Out! saves, including the Frosty Planet, Bionic Booster, Prehistoric Planet and Aquatic Planet packs.
no-save.headline: Edit a saved colony
no-save.intro: Duplicity opens an Oxygen Not Included save file, lets you change what is inside it, and writes a new one back out. Everything happens in this browser tab — the save is never uploaded anywhere.
no-save.backup_detail: Duplicity can write a file the game refuses to load, and a clean load here is no proof the game will accept the result.
no-save.save_versions: Save versions 7.28 through 7.38; a newer save loads only behind an explicit override.
no-save.step_edit_detail: Duplicants, geysers, creatures, asteroids and stored materials each get a page in the sidebar. They stay locked until a save is open, and the Overview then says what this colony actually has.
no-save.step_save_title: Save, then move the file back
no-save.step_save_detail: Save downloads a new <sav>.sav</sav> named after the colony — it does not write over the original. Put that file in <dir>save_files</dir> in place of the copy you backed up, then load the colony in game.

overview-page.destination_empty: Nothing of this kind in this colony.
overview-page.destination_duplicants: Names, traits, interests, skills, attributes, health and appearance. Revive the dead.
overview-page.destination_geysers: How much it puts out, how often it erupts, and how long it lies dormant.
overview-page.destination_creatures: Critters and their eggs, wherever they are in the colony.
overview-page.destination_worlds: Asteroid names, and which ones the colony has discovered or visited.
overview-page.destination_materials: Mass and element of everything lying around or held in a container.
overview-page.destination_raw: Every field in the save, exactly as it is stored.
overview-page.caution_materials: Deletes and mass edits apply colony-wide
overview-page.caution_raw: No checks — a bad value crashes the game
overview-page.hand_back: When you are done, Save downloads <file>{{file}}</file> to your downloads folder — it does not touch the file you opened. Move it into <dir>save_files</dir> to play it.
overview-page.sandbox_hint: Unlocks the game's own build-anything tools next time you play.
